name: Pool of Ask'ar
summary: Naga invaders and aquatic beasts crowd the Pool of Ask'ar, deep within Blackfathom Deeps. Its submerged halls hold night elven stonework and passages into the corrupted sanctuary.

sections.title: Depths of the Sunken Grotto
sections.body: Past the Drowned Sacellum, cold, murky water fills the Pool of Ask'ar beneath a vast cavern vault. Oversized snapping turtles and deep-sea crabs nest among natural caverns and ancient stonework, watched over by Ghamoo-ra, an enormous ancient chelonian. Naga have seized the temple and use this flooded threshold to guard the approaches leading deeper into the complex, toward Lady Sarevess and the Moonshrine Ruins.

sections.title: Secrets Beneath the Surface
sections.body: The Pool of Ask'ar hides relics from the shrine's past before the Sundering, beyond its dangerous creatures and naga patrols. Submerged ledges and hidden alcoves along the cavern's edges hold lost artifacts, including the Lorgalis Manuscript sought by Gerrig Bonegrip, a dwarven scholar from Ironforge. Swim through the flooded southern passages to reach dry tunnels guarded by vile murlocs and Old God cultists. The pool remains a vital waterway through Blackfathom Deeps.

faq.q: What is the Pool of Ask'ar?
faq.answer: Past the Drowned Sacellum, the vast Pool of Ask'ar lies deep within Blackfathom Deeps. Snapping turtles, crabs, and naga guards crowd its waters.

faq.q: Who lives in this subterranean pool?
faq.answer: Snapping turtles and crabs inhabit the cavern, with Ghamoo-ra, a colossal turtle, among them. Hostile naga patrol the submerged banks and nearby chambers.

faq.q: Where do the underwater tunnels lead?
faq.answer: The flooded southern passages lead toward chambers occupied by Lady Sarevess and Argent Guard Thaelrid. They also open onto a route past Gelihast toward the Moonshrine Ruins.

faq.q: What notable items can be found in the pool?
faq.answer: The submerged ruins around the pool hold the Lorgalis Manuscript, an ancient text on the Old Gods sought by Gerrig Bonegrip of Ironforge.

angles.text: For night elves, the pool drowns grounds once holy to Elune, submerging ancient architecture and leaving sacred relics such as the Lorgalis Manuscript for naga to scavenge.
As an Alliance member, you must breach the waterways to uncover Argent Guard Thaelrid's fate. He entered these depths on a holy mission against the Twilight's Hammer.
